title: Turntable card stack spin
summary: Four large square cards lie overlapped on black and the whole stack turns like a turntable: a slow constant drift, then a quick ramped step that brings the next card to the front, twice in 8 s. Constant motion with two accents.
use_when: Showing three to five finished visuals (posts, covers, product shots) as one set
A silent loop for a portfolio, template pack or feature tier page
A background plate behind a headline that needs motion but no story
Any brand with strong flat colour where the cards carry the palette

look.type_style: no headline type; small grotesk labels printed inside the card images only (about 4 % H, sentence case)

sfx.event: ramped step brings the next card to the front

structure.shot: four square cards overlapped on black: product photo card centre-left, patterned poster right, two more cut by the edges
structure.camera: static frame; the stack itself turns clockwise about a pivot near centre-bottom, about 13 deg/s
structure.motion: whole stack rotates as one rigid group, easings.linear, about 0.43 deg/fr; no card moves on its own (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the stack swings one step: the patterned poster card takes the centre, the photo card slides to the lower right
structure.camera: static frame; stack scale pulses about +7 % then back (motion.json 1-3 s)
structure.motion: ramped step, easings.inOutSine 23 fr (±0.25 s); peak about 45 deg/s over the second, one card slot of travel

structure.shot: pale blue poster card leads at centre-left, patterned poster right, yellow card with a hand-held tablet enters from the left
structure.camera: static frame; stack keeps turning clockwise about 13 deg/s
structure.motion: same linear drift, easings.linear about 0.43 deg/fr, 90 fr hold (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: second step: the yellow tablet card swings to the centre, the pale card exits lower right, the patterned card returns top left
structure.camera: static frame; stack scale dips about 9 % during the step (motion.json 5-6 s)
structure.motion: ramped step, easings.inOutSine 22 fr (±0.25 s); same travel as row 2

structure.shot: patterned poster at centre-top, photo card back at the left, yellow tablet card right: close to the opening layout
structure.camera: static frame; stack drifts clockwise about 13 deg/s to the end
structure.motion: linear drift, easings.linear about 0.43 deg/fr, 60 fr (±0.25 s); ends without a stop

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the empty frame, accent and surface tint the default cards
params.content.cards: 3-5 square images (1:1), drawn as cards about 0.6 H wide
params.timing.stepAt: frames at 30 fps where a ramped step starts (default [45, 158])
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; pivot stays at centre-bottom, card size follows H
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: One shot, no cuts, silent. Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s) and motion.json: in-plane rotation about 13 deg/s during drift, about 45 deg/s averaged over the step seconds (1-2 s and 5-6 s), scale +7.4 %/s then -6.1 %/s around step one, -9.2 %/s at step two. The cards are flat; no 3D flip is visible despite the catalogue hint. Proposed term turntable-spin (rigid in-plane rotation of an overlapped card stack) is not in the vocabulary and not used as a technique id. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured.
